listing.name: Front Mission 3 — Front-Mission-3-PC (ITSeniy)
listing.summary: Upstream reports gameplay, full-motion videos and audio. Playthrough A testing and investigation of scheduling after training continue; Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-01011 Front Mission 3 disc in CUE/BIN form and your own SCPH1001.BIN BIOS. Keep those originals separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to generate and build from your own disc and BIOS using the included framework, then run Front_Mission_3_Recompiled.exe. Captured overlays compile locally. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.
